version.changelog: Drops the _v1 suffix everywhere (folder now context_pipeline)

llm.summary: The skill’s files, scripts, and runtime instructions are coherent with its stated purpose (a deterministic retrieval + compression pipeline) and do not request unrelated credentials or network installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (deterministic memory/context pipeline) matches the included assets, schemas, router, compressor prompt, and three helper scripts. Required env vars/binaries/credentials are none, which is proportionate for a file-based pipeline spec.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions require the agent to copy the provided asset bundle into the workspace, patch AGENTS.md, run a validator, and emit Retrieval Bundle + Context Pack artifacts (including raw snippets and paths). These actions are consistent with the pipeline's evidence contract, but they will cause the agent to read and publish workspace memory files (full snippet text and paths) into the transcript — this is expected for the skill's purpose but is a privacy exposure to be aware of.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No network downloads or package installs; install is instruction-only plus a local script that copies assets from the skill package into workspace/context_pipeline. Copying uses shutil.copytree with dirs_exist_ok=True so it will overwrite existing files in the target bundle (expected for an installer/refresh).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The scripts operate on local filesystem paths only and do not call external services or require secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated platform privileges. It does modify workspace files (creates/overwrites context_pipeline/ and instructs patching AGENTS.md), which is appropriate for installing a pipeline spec but should be tracked in source control.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and does what it says: install a local context-pipeline spec and enforce an evidence contract. Before installing, back up your repo or ensure files are under git (the installer will overwrite files in workspace/context_pipeline and you will be asked to patch AGENTS.md). Critically, the runtime contract requires printing Retrieval Bundle JSON and Context Pack JSON including snippet text and paths — if your workspace memory files contain secrets or sensitive PII, those will be surfaced in transcripts. If that's acceptable, proceed; if not, remove or redact sensitive memory files first or review the assets locally and run the installer/validator in an isolated environment.
